profile.headline: Startup-to-Scale Engineering Specialist

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Scaling the SignalFlag.AI (fka ReSim) platform to run your physical AI testing workloads across clouds and on-prem.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Created the "Fleet Reliability Engineer" or "SRE for Vehicles" role - treating AV development as a data pipeline while building the foundations of a production autonomous fleet.
Developed systems for all stages of AV development - build/release, onboard device management, real time monitoring, security, large-scale data extraction, etc.
Grew a team to develop and support the production systems both onboard and off, including real time troubleshooting of integration issues across multiple disciplines from embedded devices to cloud.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Projects supported including:
* Large-scale ML training pipelines before they were called "AI".
* Real-time payments processing systems including external vendor integrations.

Focus skills on:
* Organization-wide resource management.
* Monitoring and performance tuning
* Software deployment

Education and training for all new SRE hires and transfers.
